@graph.howPerformed: Follicular units are extracted one by one from the donor area with semi-automated instruments 0.7–0.8 mm in diameter. The scalp is prepared with Growth Factor Therapy (GFT) before implantation. The extracted follicles are preserved in a temperature-controlled solution to support growth after they are implanted.

acceptedAnswer.text: The procedure is done under local anesthesia, so discomfort is minimal during surgery and recovery.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hair growth usually starts in 3–4 months, with full results visible within 12 months.

mainEntity.name: Will the transplanted hair look natural?

acceptedAnswer.text: The NFT method is designed to create natural hairlines and density that blend in with your existing hair.

mainEntity.name: What care is needed after a hair transplant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid alcohol and smoking for 7 days before surgery. Afterwards, avoid heavy physical activity for 2 weeks and follow your prescribed hair care routine.
